meta.note: Target state, not a mirror. Where the site was consistent and legible, values are today's; where it wasn't, one variant was picked. Near-duplicates were folded into one token. See the Retired and Decisions sections.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and input fill. Also the text colour on teal-deep (6.9:1), maroon (12.8:1), night (16:1) and the maroon-wash banner.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Background of calendar event callouts and of empty media slots. Text on it is ink (12.1:1); slate drops to 4.3:1 here, so don't use it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, callout text, and any text on the tints, sun (6.2:1) or teal (4.8:1). 12.8:1 on surface. Body copy too, if Decision 9 goes that way.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Body copy (Decision 9), captions, form labels, fact labels, meta text and input borders, on surface only (4.55:1, with nothing to spare). Never on a tint or surface-soft, where it drops to 4.2 to 4.3:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between rows (Details, facts tables). Decorative only (1.3:1): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The logo's teal. Fill for the Band, the phone menu and the 'Other' event accent. Text on it is ink (4.8:1). Never a text colour on white (2.6:1) and never under white text (Decision 2).

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Header background, links and the focus ring on light grounds (6.9:1 on surface), Frame colour one, Button hover fill. White text on it: 6.9:1.

tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Promo bar, the enquiry Band, the 'Concert' event accent, Frame colour two, Light-button hover. White text on it: 12.8:1; sun on it: 6.2:1.

tokens.name: maroon-wash
tokens.usage: The Banner's overlay: maroon at 75% over a photograph, so the white H1 always reads.

tokens.name: maroon-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the next-gig callout. ink on it: 11.3:1.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Primary Button fill with ink text (6.2:1), Frame colour three, the 'Play-along' event accent, text selection. A fill only: never text on white (2.1:1), never under white text (2.1:1).

tokens.name: sun-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the next-session callout. ink on it: 11.7:1.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Footer background, both the main footer and the copyright bar. on-night text 7.9:1, white headings and links 16:1.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Footer body text and the copyright line, on night only (7.9:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error messages only, on surface (5.0:1). Always with words that say what went wrong; never colour alone.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The H1, once per page, inside the Banner, in surface (white). 2 to 5 words. Same size on phones today (Decision 11).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage:
Section headings, and the one sentence in a Band (set as a

, not a heading). Same size on phones today (Decision 11).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a section: FAQ questions, the callout headline. In ink. Replaces the old h5 style.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Free, every Tuesday from 8pm, upstairs at The Stag's Head.
styles.usage: The Banner subtitle and a page's opening line. One per page at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring your ukulele (or borrow one of ours) and join our big, friendly singalong.
styles.usage: All paragraphs, lists and fact tables, in slate (Decision 9).

styles.name: button-text
styles.usage: Button labels, shown in uppercase by the Button CSS. Type them in sentence case in the template. No letter-spacing, no arrows.

styles.name: nav-text
styles.usage: Desktop nav links: uppercase with 1px letter-spacing, surface on teal-deep (Decision 7). The header's small Button uses the same size and tracking in Poppins.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Leading a play-along on the port of Monopoli, Monopolele Festival 2023
styles.usage: Frame captions (italic, slate, centred), the copyright line, field hints.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a component: label to input, caption under a frame, the session pill's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The gutter: column padding and page side padding on phones; callout vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a column: heading to text, text to button, frame to the copy below it; callout side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between two-column rows and Book-us offers; page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a Band; footer padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a page Banner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Callouts and calendar event cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Frames, and anything else with a corner that isn't a form control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Form inputs, selects and textareas, as on the Contact and Book us forms today.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the session pill. Nothing else is a pill.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a text column, the Book-us offers and the enquiry form.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page container (header, two-column rows, footer).

tokens.name: frame-width
tokens.usage: Border width of a Frame around photos and videos.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Height of every Button, form submits included (Decision 10).

tokens.name: button-height-small
tokens.usage: Height of the header's small 'Book us' Button. Nothing else.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of text inputs and selects, as on the forms today.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Buttons at rest. It drops away on hover, as it does today (Decision 10). Not on the header's small Button.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The session pill over the Banner photo, and a calendar callout on hover.
